The University of California San Diego is seeking qualified applicants for the position of Asst AD - Digital Marketing and Revenue Strategy. UC San Diego, located in La Jolla, in the San Diego Metropolitan area, enrolls over 35,000 students and is one of the University of California’s 10 campuses. UC San Diego has earned recognition as one of the world’s premier research universities and one of the top-10 public universities in the nation. UC San Diego Athletics has a proud tradition of academic and athletic excellence, sponsors 24 varsity sports, and is a member of the NCAA Division I within the Big West Conference. Triton Athletics consistently ranks as one of the most successful athletic programs, ranking among the top 10 nationally in the Learfield Director’s Cup in 19 of the past 23 years.

Reporting directly to the Associate Athletic Director for Marketing & NIL Strategy, the Assistant Athletic Director of Digital Marketing and Revenue Strategy creates and implements a comprehensive marketing and revenue strategy for department digital outlets, such as social media, email and text messaging, search engine optimization and web-based advertising. The position is responsible for content generation through @ucsdtritons social media channels (Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, and YouTube), and collaborates in the management of individual team related accounts to promote and protect the UC San Diego athletics brand and to maximize interest, drive revenue, drive attendance, create affinity and revenue opportunities and increase external engagement. The Assistant Athletic Director is responsible for managing news, content, and campaigns on @ucsdtritons main social media accounts and maintains a cross-channel content calendar to maximize interaction and engagement. Builds and nurtures online communities, actively engages with users, identifies brand advocates/influencers, and implements processes and procedures to regularly test, measure and improve digital engagement.

The Assistant Athletic Director is a seasoned expert when it comes to the latest social media and digital marketing platforms, tools, and technologies. They drive organization-wide social media efforts, stay on the leading edge of trends and technologies, and advocate for new approaches that advance the department and its goals. Serves as a strong facilitator and liaison to ensure alignment with and advance the institutional mission and goals. The incumbent will follow operating philosophies consistent with that of UC San Diego, the Athletic Department, the NCAA, and all related governing organizations, and maintain a deep commitment to diversity in all of its forms. Triton Athletics promotes the pursuit of excellence, the strength of character, teamwork, ethical conduct, and diversity and is inextricably linked to the educational mission of the University.

Thorough understanding of technical language and requirements of the assigned work. Extensive skills in audience targeting and paid promotion of digital media posts and web-based advertising campaigns.

Thorough knowledge of content management systems and / or relevant web applications used for web production and organization-specific computer application programs. Demonstrated skills in utilizing social media platforms including Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, etc, and strategies to leverage these channels.

Thorough understanding of organization's processes, procedures, and applicable rules and regulations for web communications. In-depth understanding of maintaining brand equity and demonstrated ability to adhere to brand guidelines. Knowledge of effective storytelling principles and ability to write succinct, evocative and engaging digital media content..

Thorough skills to develop and implement original ideas and correctly identify and effectively solve problems. Problem-solving skills; multi-task, work with frequent interruptions, and effective listener. Ability to prioritize and handle multiple projects and deadlines in a fast paced environment. Ability to identify and implement methods, procedures, and policies. Ability to use good judgment for problem solving.

Demonstrated supervisory skills, including the ability to train, motivate, and evaluate student employees, interns and volunteers; to delegate tasks; to schedule sufficient staffing for simultaneous athletic events based on knowledge of all schedules and the needs for sporting events.

Thorough interpersonal communication skills. Interpersonal skills including assertiveness, tact, flexibility, attentive/reflective listening, respectfulness, diplomacy, flexibility and patience. Demonstrated ability to interact effectively with individuals across the range of academic and professional backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, ethnicities, cultures and other personal factors, both inside and outside the organization. Proven excellent communication skills, both oral and written, to provide information with content that is concise and appropriate for the intended audience. Ability to maintain composure while under the stress, pressure and time-sensitive demands of the job.
Demonstrated the ability to follow the athletic philosophy consistent with that of the UC San Diego Athletic Department and NCAA, and a commitment to diversity in all of its forms.
Knowledge and strong interest in college athletics, game production, social media, and digital marketing.

Strong organizational skills including ability to prioritize time, plan, and follow projects through to completion. Strong demonstrated ability to prioritize multiple tasks and meet multiple deadlines in a dynamic environment with numerous interruptions and fluctuating priorities. Ability to develop and adjust routines and procedures as needed. Ability to meet established deadlines, with attention to detail and a keen focus on quality.

Must maintain current knowledge of applicable rules and standards of the affiliated athletic conference and the National Collegiate Athletic Association (NCAA), as well as other associations and agencies to which the campus adheres, and, at all times avoid any and all violations of these rules and standards. Understanding and adherence to all Big West Conference and NCAA rules and regulations.
